name: LogoAI
tagline: LogoAI is an AI logo maker that generates unique, vector-based logos from your company name, industry, and style preferences. Unlike template-based tools, its generator tries to produce original marks rather than remixing existing icons. The output includes SVG files, brand colour palettes, and mockups on business cards and social profiles.
